column1: # ONLINE-BUDGET (#257): the share of --max-online allowed at each hour (UTC; with --day-secs the compressed day spread over 24).
# Format: hour<TAB>fraction, all 24 hours 0-23 once, fraction 0 to 1; '#' starts a comment.
# Limit at an hour = floor(N x fraction). An invented shape, not extracted data.
# Every row is [A]: an evening peak and a night trough like a player population's.
# Falsifier: the owner reading the [soc] online series against the hours he plays.
